usage: Used to relieve pain and reduce fever.
dosage: Usually 1 tablet every 4-6 hours as needed. Do not exceed 4 tablets in 24 hours. Consult a doctor for specific guidance.
warnings: Avoid alcohol while taking this medicine.
Liver damage can occur with overdose.
Do not take with other Paracetamol containing products.
storage: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.

usage: Relieves headache, muscle pain, and fever.
dosage: 1-2 tablets every 4-6 hours. Max 8 tablets in 24 hours. Seek professional advice.
warnings: Chronic alcoholics should use with caution.
Report any severe skin reactions to a doctor immediately.
storage: Store below 30°C.

usage: Used for treatment of acid reflux and peptic ulcers.
dosage: Usually one tablet daily in the morning before food. Consult your doctor.
warnings: Inform doctor if you have kidney or liver problems.
May decrease absorption of Vitamin B12 with long-term use.
storage: Store at room temperature away from moisture.

usage: Used to treat gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and acidity with nausea.
dosage: One capsule daily, preferably in the morning before breakfast. Consult a physician.
warnings: Should not be used by patients with known heart rhythm issues.
Caution in patients with kidney disease.
storage: Keep in a cool and dry place.

usage: Broad-spectrum antibiotic used to treat bacterial infections of the respiratory tract, ear, and skin.
dosage: Usually one tablet once daily for 3 to 5 days. Complete the full course as prescribed.
warnings: Finish the entire course to prevent antibiotic resistance.
May cause heart rhythm disturbances in some patients.
storage: Store in a cool and dry place.

usage: Treats bacterial infections of the lungs, urinary tract, and skin.
dosage: One tablet twice daily after food for the prescribed duration. Seek doctor's guidance.
warnings: Do not use if allergic to Penicillin.
May cause liver dysfunction with prolonged use.
storage: Keep in the original pack to protect from moisture. Store below 25°C.

usage: Used for bacterial infections of the urinary tract, ear, throat, and typhoid fever.
dosage: Commonly 1 tablet twice daily for 5-10 days. Follow physician's advice.
warnings: Inform your doctor if you are allergic to Cephalosporins.
Monitor kidney function if used long-term.
storage: Store in a cool, dry place.

usage: Reduces pain, swelling, and inflammation in conditions like arthritis and gout.
dosage: One tablet daily after food. Do not crush or chew. Consult a doctor.
warnings: May increase risk of heart attack or stroke with long-term use.
Avoid in patients with stomach ulcers.
storage: Protect from heat and light.

usage: Relieves mild to moderate pain like muscle ache, dental pain, and fever.
dosage: One tablet up to three times a day after food. Consult a healthcare professional.
warnings: Use with caution in asthma patients.
Avoid if you have history of gastrointestinal bleeding.
storage: Store in a cool, dry place.

usage: Relieves allergy symptoms like sneezing, runny nose, itchy eyes, and skin rashes.
dosage: Usually one tablet daily. Consult your physician for exact dosage.
warnings: Do not take with fruit juices like apple, orange, or grapefruit.
Consult doctor if pregnant or breastfeeding.
storage: Store below 30°C.

usage: Common antihistamine used for treating cold symptoms and skin allergies.
dosage: Typically one tablet at bedtime. Consult a doctor.
warnings: May cause drowsiness; avoid driving or operating machinery.
Limit alcohol consumption.
storage: Store in a cool and dry place.

usage: Relieves cough associated with mucus, bronchitis, and bronchial asthma.
dosage: Typically 5-10 ml three times a day. Follow your doctor's prescription.
warnings: Caution in patients with heart disease or high blood pressure.
Not recommended for children without medical advice.
storage: Store in a cool place away from light.

usage: Used for temporary relief of dry cough and common cold symptoms.
dosage: Adults: 5-10 ml, 3-4 times a day. Consult a healthcare provider.
warnings: Avoid driving after use due to sedation.
Should not be taken with MAO inhibitors.
storage: Store below 30°C.

usage: Antacid used to relieve acidity, gas, heartburn, and bloating.
dosage: Chew 2-4 tablets after meals or at bedtime. Consult a physician.
warnings: Do not take for more than 2 weeks without medical advice.
Caution in patients with kidney disease.
storage: Keep in a cool and dry place.

usage: Used to control blood sugar levels in patients with Type 2 diabetes.
dosage: One tablet once or twice daily with meals. Follow doctor's instructions strictly.
warnings: Risk of lactic acidosis in rare cases.
Monitor kidney and liver function regularly.
storage: Store at room temperature.

usage: Used to treat high blood pressure (hypertension) and prevent chest pain (angina).
dosage: One tablet daily at the same time. Consult your doctor.
warnings: Do not stop taking without consulting your doctor.
Inform doctor if you have liver problems.
storage: Protect from moisture and light.

usage: Used to lower 'bad' cholesterol (LDL) and triglycerides in the blood.
dosage: One tablet daily, preferably in the evening. Consult a healthcare professional.
warnings: Inform doctor if you experience unexplained muscle pain.
Not for use during pregnancy.
storage: Store below 25°C.

usage: Supplement used to treat calcium and Vitamin D deficiency for healthy bones.
dosage: Usually one tablet daily after food. Follow doctor's recommendation.
warnings: Monitor blood calcium levels if taken for a long time.
Inform doctor if you have kidney stones.
storage: Store in a cool and dry place.

usage: Treats Vitamin C deficiency and helps in immunity and skin health.
dosage: One tablet daily to be chewed or swallowed. Consult a professional.
warnings: Large doses can cause kidney stones in predisposed individuals.
Caution in diabetic patients.
storage: Keep away from moisture and heat.

usage: Vitamin supplement to treat deficiencies and improve overall health and energy.
dosage: One capsule daily after meals. Consult a doctor.
warnings: Consult doctor if you have any pre-existing health conditions.
Do not exceed recommended dose.
storage: Store in a cool, dry and dark place.

usage: Antiseptic for minor cuts, wounds, and burns to prevent infection.
dosage: Clean the area and apply a small amount 1-3 times daily. Consult a doctor for deep wounds.
warnings: Avoid contact with eyes.
Consult doctor if wound does not heal or worsens.
Inform doctor of thyroid problems if using large areas.
storage: Store at room temperature. Keep away from fire.

usage: Used for quick relief from muscle pain, back pain, and joint pain.
dosage: Apply locally to the affected area 3-4 times a day. Do not apply on open wounds.
warnings: For external use only.
Wash hands after application.
Do not use with heating pads.
storage: Store in a cool place. Do not freeze.

usage: Nasal decongestant used for relief from blocked nose due to cold or allergies.
dosage: 1-2 drops into each nostril up to 3 times a day. Consult a doctor for use beyond 3 days.
warnings: Do not use for more than 5 consecutive days (risk of rebound congestion).
Consult doctor if you have high blood pressure.
storage: Store below 30°C.

usage: Used to treat bacterial infections in eyes and ears.
dosage: Instill 1-2 drops into the affected eye/ear as directed by your doctor.
warnings: Do not touch the dropper tip to any surface.
Remove contact lenses before use in eyes.
Complete course to avoid resistance.
storage: Store in a cool and dry place.

usage: Quick-relief medication for asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).
dosage: Commonly 1-2 puffs when needed. Consult your doctor for specific use.
warnings: Carry it always for emergency use.
Inform doctor if breathing issues worsen.
Check heart status regularly.
storage: Store below 30°C. Protect from sunlight. Do not puncture.
